Whether the old tunnel (w150549083) and old footbridge (w26380520) are still usable on 2026-10-30: not stated.
Lokaltog platforms (tracks 11/12, new) and their numbering: not in Bilag 3.6 or any source read.

DSB's page gives no lift/stairs info; it predates the rebuild in places. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: DSB having no lift text is consistent with the lifts not yet being installed (Banedanmark, 12 Oct 2026). Positions are still unknown.]

answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Hillerød)
answers.answer: The station is mid-rebuild (Feb 2026–Sep 2027). A new footbridge across all tracks opened on 12 Oct 2026; its lifts are due by the end of 2026, and until then step-free access is from the west side (reserved for those who need it). The old footbridge and tunnel in OSM are being removed/closed, so OSM is likely stale here.
